Lee: diagnosis with a short-route preference
Lee is fascinated by differential diagnosis and explains case stories from a school health club. Lee currently hopes to start earning quickly and chooses dental assisting preparation, despite preferring physician responsibilities in the role questions. These are two real preferences to discuss rather than proof the routes are interchangeable. Lee wants an expensive future lifestyle before understanding its training timeline.
Fictional development case. Includes shared scripted defaults.

LIFESTYLE 1. Where would you feel at home?
Answer: Room to spread out — A larger apartment or rental home.
Choices: Share a place — A room of your own. Shared living space. | A small place — A modest apartment with the basics. | My own space — A comfortable one-bedroom apartment. | [selected] Room to spread out — A larger apartment or rental home. | A standout home — A high-end home with extra space and comforts.
